digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler coordinator and mutation adapter layer
propositions: Every supported Cloud/DC mutation must route through exactly one typed coordinator/adapter path with no hidden SDK, generic wrapper, _best_effort, or duck-typed production fallback remaining reachable.
Unsupported production actions must fail before local or remote effects with a typed provider-neutral error.
Cursor, baseline, and binding state must advance only for proven postconditions; deferred, failed, skipped, and commit-unknown work must never be counted as applied and must remain recoverable.
The repair_at_write_boundary call in reconcile.py must execute after the under-lock staleness validation and before the pass's first remote issue fetch to prevent silent correctness violations.
Preview, manifest, and logs must preserve existing mutation fields while adding versioned, redacted lifecycle, delay/budget, disposition, fuse, and retry_not_before data.
Portable verified-fake Cloud/DC end-to-end suites must cover retry envelope, fuse, create containment, restart, and partial-outcome behavior without external credentials.
